notes: A191303_k5 ... A191303_k11, A191303_k13: explicit degree-k polynomials P_k(s) that are k-digit half-palindromes for every s (b, c = b+1 or b+2, digits linear in s), found by Hermite-normal-form enumeration of the integer solution lattice of the linear identity; the entry says k >= 5 was open. k = 12 and k >= 14 open (no linear family with c = b+1 and slope <= 160 at k = 12, slope <= 120 at k = 14).  Outside Lean: none for k = 5..11, 13 beyond reading that P_k has degree k.

prior_art.note: Entry says k >= 5 unknown; families for k = 5..11 are ours.
